A dart decided my trip through the world 🎯🌎 I threw a dart at a map of the entire world and traveled to wherever it landed, just to make a little video about that place.😎 Hi, I’m plutoopictures and this is another version of my Random-Dart-Edit series. In every episode, I try to capture the place where the dart lands through a short video edit. I only have around 20–30 seconds, but my goal is to bring the full vibe of that little piece of Earth to the screen in a quick, stylish summary of its culture, mentality, atmosphere, and unique details.🌍 And just a little disclaimer: I swear on my new Sony A7 V that this was actually real! 😂 I genuinely didn’t aim for Canada or anything, it just happened to be the first country the dart hit, honestly I would have prefered something more „exotic“😂  Music choice: Drake: Started From the Bottom, Energy, Massive Justin Bieber: Eye Candy Oh Canada: National Anthem #canada #mattawa #travel

Troy, North Carolina ~ Circa 1936-40" refers to the rare local documentary silent film footage captured in the town by traveling photographer H. Lee Waters. Historical Context of the Footage, The Filmmaker:  H. Lee Waters traveled through small towns in North Carolina, South Carolina, and Virginia during the Great Depression era, filming everyday people on Main Street, local school children, and downtown merchants. The Collection: Known as Movies of Local People, the original reels for Troy are preserved in archival repositories like the Duke Digital Repository, offering a vivid window into daily life in Montgomery County just before World War II. #fypシ゚viral #fyp #BlackHistory #blacktiktoker #blackhistorytiktok

Our first ever family vlog!!! (2 dads and a 6 month old travelling to Crete) 🥹✈️ I’m definitely no content creator 😂 but I actually think it turned out quite cute considering I filmed it and somehow managed to edit the whole thing myself. 🤣 I was so nervous about a 10-hour travel day with a 6-month-old, but honestly… I had no reason to be. She was an absolute little superstar. 🥹❤️ She still fitted in the sling (just 😂), although a very enthusiastic jobsworth made me take her out for take-off, so she was a little restless at first. As soon as we were allowed, she went back in and slept for a couple of hours. We packed a few toys to keep her entertained too and so many people came over to tell us what a content little girl she was, which was so lovely to hear. So all in all, it genuinely couldn’t have gone much better. Now it’s time to make some memories as our little family. ❤️  PS… you’ll have to let me know what you think of the vlog. Should I continue or should I retire after this one? 🤣
